name: pdfops-sdk
description: Typed client for the PDFops API — deterministic PDF fill, merge, and inspect over HTTP, plus page operations (extract, delete, rotate, split, watermark, page numbers), unlock/protect, and metadata. Edge-safe: works in Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Deno, Bun, Node 18+, and browsers.
author: PDFops <hello@pdfops.dev> (https://pdfops.dev)
